outcome: incidence of on-treatment severe asthma exacerbations during follow-up

citations.text: Other endpoints included change from baseline in Asthma Control Test™ (ACT) score, change in percentage of patients whose asthma was controlled (ACT score ≥ 20) after 24 weeks, incidence of on-treatment severe asthma exacerbations, and incidence of on-treatment unscheduled asthma-related healthcare utilisation.
Severe exacerbations (ATS/ERS taskforce definition [20]) were reported by 13 (12%) patients in the FF 200 μg group and 14 (13%) in the FF 100 μg group.
The primary and secondary efficacy endpoints were analysed using an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) model with effects due to baseline measurement, region, sex, age and treatment group.
